scope: Bounded static review of two independent process slots per authorized physical GPU, run claiming, leases, process isolation, and training/resume fairness. No training or evaluation execution performed by reviewer; no test files or locked test artifacts read.

authorization.source: Parent relayed latest explicit user authorization superseding older one-process-per-GPU instruction

checks.name: authorized_gpu_and_slot_bounds
checks.evidence: gpu_queue rejects GPU outside GPUS and slots outside range(WORKERS_PER_GPU); source constants are [0,1,2,3] and 2.

checks.name: lease_compatibility
checks.evidence: Slot 0 retains gpu-N flock; slot 1 uses gpu-N-slot-1 flock. One sequential child per queue holds its slot throughout child execution. Existing slot-0 lease remains compatible.

checks.name: process_gpu_binding
checks.evidence: _child invokes pixi run env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<physical GPU> MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=<physical GPU> and passes --gpu to a fresh Python process. gpu_context reasserts environment inside Pixi before importing training/evaluation. Child receives live parent lease PID.

checks.name: independent_training_state
checks.evidence: Each run uses a new Python child, isolated CUDA graph/compile runtime, Trainer, optimizer, EMA and loader/diffusion RNGs. No Trainer reuse or shared optimizer/model state is introduced.

checks.name: fixed_training_budget
checks.evidence: Training config remains 20,000 updates, batch and microbatch 128, fixed seeds and AdamW/EMA. CLI/common are absent from training source_identity; orchestration changes do not change checkpoint training identity.

checks.name: resume_state
checks.evidence: Restore validates metadata/config/normalization/initial weights and restores model, EMA, optimizer, step, pairing digest and loader/diffusion/Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG states. Exclusive per-run flock protects train and evaluation writes.

checks.name: atomic_run_claims
checks.evidence: All gpu_queue claims occur under common scheduler flock and manifest mutations under manifest flock. Per-run flock blocks concurrent training/evaluation body execution; stale reconciliation and old-child cleanup have races recorded below.

checks.name: live_extension_coexistence
checks.evidence: Parent reports slot-1 direct gpu_queue launcher PID 630158, bypassing orchestrator/reconcile, alongside existing slot-0 scheduler PID 227554. Reviewer did not launch GPU work or independently validate live utilization.

operational_findings.detail: A training worker marks train complete before its child process fully exits. Another queue can claim dev while old run lock is still held; worker can fail acquiring the lock, or old _child cleanup can unconditionally clear ownership metadata belonging to the new child. Exclusive run lock protects artifact integrity, but a queue may stop or ownership fields may become incomplete.
operational_findings.minimum_followup: Under scheduler lock, exclude live pid/worker_pid/launcher_pid from eligible records and condition cleanup on matching launcher_pid. Do not exclude scheduler_pid alone.

operational_findings.detail: reconcile_stale_runs currently inspects records outside scheduler lock. Concurrent reconciliation may reset a freshly claimed run before its child acquires the per-run lock. Direct slot-1 extension does not call reconciliation.
operational_findings.minimum_followup: Serialize stale-run snapshot, live-process checks and run-lock-protected reset using the shared scheduler lock.

operational_findings.detail: Per-run gpu_active_work_seconds measure synchronized allocated-device wall time, not exclusive GPU kernel time. Concurrent workers overlap; sums are not physical GPU occupancy, and pre/post-concurrency run timing is not directly comparable without concurrency context.

limits: Static inspection does not establish bitwise equivalence for every completed run or measure throughput/memory headroom.
Existing live slot-0 and slot-1 parent processes retain their loaded code; subsequent on-disk guard fixes do not retroactively resolve those parents.
No model, data, frozen configuration, split ID, prior run record, or training source was edited by this reviewer.
